about: 25 questions about Grandma's trunk with known answers and the documents that hold them. Used by evals.py in Part 3. 'kind' groups the tests: meaning (found by meaning, not words), filter (a year, person or type), table (a number inside a table), total (needs the bills tool), form (a field on a form), date (a date the answer must get exactly right), refuse (not in the trunk: the right answer is 'I don't know').

questions.question: When did Grandpa move to Mumbai?
questions.answer: March 1968, when his railway office was transferred to Bombay

questions.question: What is Grandma's kheer recipe?
questions.answer: Milk, old rice, sugar, cardamom, saffron and almonds; boil the milk, cook the rice on a low flame for about 45 minutes, stir slowly, never rush

questions.question: What did Grandpa think when he first saw the sea?
questions.answer: That the sea is very big; he stood at the shore like a schoolboy and thought of Kamla and the children

questions.question: When did Grandpa get his first job?
questions.answer: He joined the Railway Office in Jabalpur as a Junior Clerk on 2 April 1962

questions.question: When did Grandpa become Head Clerk?
questions.answer: From 1 July 1975

questions.question: When did the family buy their own flat?
questions.answer: November 1979 (registered 12 November 1979), Flat 6, Shanti Niwas, Goregaon

questions.question: Where did Arun study engineering?
questions.answer: At the College of Engineering in Pune, from July 1983

questions.question: Why did Meera want to become a teacher, and where did she apply?
questions.answer: She decided after passing Class 12 in 1986 and applied to the teachers' training college in Dadar

questions.question: What happened in 1975?
questions.answer: Republic Day at home, the first monsoon rain and Mohan's promotion to Head Clerk, his trip to Delhi, Usha's wedding being fixed, Diwali with a new pressure cooker and mixer, and Arun's Class V report card

questions.question: What do Grandma's diaries from 1983 say?
questions.answer: India won the cricket World Cup (25 June), Arun left for engineering college in Pune (16 July), and at year end they bought a black-and-white TV and Meera topped her class

questions.question: Which letters did Savitri write?
questions.answer: Two: August 1965, congratulating Kamla on Arun's birth, and September 1975, about Usha's wedding

questions.question: Show me all of Grandma's recipes.
questions.answer: Dal Tadka (1966), Aloo Paratha (1969), Kheer (1971), Besan Ladoo (1974), Kanda Poha (1978), Mango Pickle (1982)

questions.question: How much was the July 1985 electricity bill?
How many units of electricity did the family use in May 1985?
questions.answer: 178 units (the highest month of 1985), Rs 133.00

questions.question: How much did the family spend on electricity in 1985?
questions.answer: Rs 1,284.00 across 12 bills (January to December 1985)

questions.question: Which month of 1985 had the highest electricity bill?
What marks did Arun get in Mathematics in 1979?
questions.answer: 92 out of 100, grade A (Class IX, 1978-79)

questions.question: Who was on the family's ration card in 1969?
questions.answer: Mohan (34), Kamla (28), Arun (3) and Meera (under 1)

questions.question: How much rent did the family pay in 1972?
questions.answer: Rs 150 a month, with a Rs 600 deposit

questions.question: When was Meera born?
questions.answer: 14 February 1968

questions.question: When were Grandma and Grandpa married?
questions.answer: Sunday 12 May 1963, at Pathak Bhavan, Indore

questions.question: When was Arun born?
questions.answer: 3 August 1965, in Jabalpur

questions.question: What car did Grandpa drive?
questions.answer: I don't know: nothing in the trunk mentions a car

questions.question: How much was the electricity bill in 1990?
questions.answer: I don't know: the trunk only has electricity bills from December 1984 to January 1986

questions.question: What was Grandpa's salary when he retired?
questions.answer: I don't know: the trunk has his first salary (Rs 180 in 1962) but nothing about his salary at retirement
